description_en: Creates a new application in a specified workspace
description_zh: 调用此接口在指定空间内创建一个新应用
kebab_example: aliyun mhub create-app --product-id 123456 --name '我的应用' --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateApp

parameters.help_en: The ID of the workspace in which the application is created
parameters.help_zh: 指定创建应用所属的空间ID
parameters.name: product_id

parameters.help_en: The application name. The name can be up to 26 characters in length and cannot contain special characters other than underscores (_)
parameters.help_zh: 应用名称。该参数长度不超过26个字符，并且不能用_以外的特殊字符
parameters.name: name

parameters.help_en:
The application type. Valid values:
    
    1: iOS
    2: Android
    8: MoPen web
    9: MoPen mobile
parameters.help_zh:
应用类型。取值范围如下：
    
    1：iOS
    2：Android
    8：魔笔网页端
    9：魔笔移动端
parameters.name: type

parameters.help_en: The iOS application ID. This parameter is required when you create an iOS application
parameters.name: bundle_id

parameters.help_en: The Android application package name. This parameter is required when you create an Android application
parameters.help_zh: Android 应用包名。创建Android应用时必填
parameters.name: package_name

parameters.help_en: The Base64-encoded string of the image
parameters.name: encoded_icon

parameters.help_en:

parameters.help_zh:
应用所属的行业ID，取值范围如下：
    
     * 0. 社交

AppInfo.description_en: The basic information about the application

AppKey.description_en: The AppKey of the application, which uniquely identifies an application in API requests
AppKey.description_zh: 应用 appkey，接口请求时唯一标识一个应用

CreateTime.description_en: The UTC time when the application was created

ModifyTime.description_en: The UTC time when the application was last modified

ProductId.description_en: The ID of the workspace to which the application belongs
